warnings.label: Christchurch Harbour
warnings.description: Christchurch Harbour
warnings.message:
High tides this evening may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 9:00PM to 1:00AM on the 29 September 2026. 
Areas most at risk include Christchurch Harbour and tidal stretches of the Lower Stour and Avon. The detailed tidal forecast for those who use it is for a peak level at Christchurch Harbour of 1.26mAODN at 11:00PM, 29 September 2026, with force 4 South Easterly winds. (mAODN is height above average sea level.). After this high tide, conditions become more settled. 
We are closing flood gates and closely monitoring the situation. 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded . 
This message will be updated by 11:00AM on 30 September 2026 or as the situation changes.
